note: Precipitation is a species of imprudence.
Thoughtlessness or inconsideration is a species of imprudence.
Inconstancy is a species of imprudence.
General or legal justice orders acts toward the common good
Particular justice concerns what is due to particular persons
Distributive justice orders the distribution of common goods to individuals
Commutative justice orders dealings between one individual and another
Theft is a form of injustice concerning another person's property
Robbery is a form of injustice involving the violent taking of another person's property
Unjust judgment is a form of injustice committed in judicial judgment
False testimony is a form of injustice committed through false witness
Detraction is a form of injustice against another person's reputation
Fraud in exchange is a form of injustice that violates equality between parties
Usury as treated by Aquinas is a form of injustice in lending
Studiousness is a form of modesty governing the desire for knowledge
Eutrapelia is a form of modesty governing play and recreation
Outward modesty moderates bodily movements and external appearance
